colors.description: Sets the current image palette from a color map file or direct color specification.

decomp.description: Colors points by the quadrant of the final orbit value instead of escape iteration bands.

distest.description: Enables distance estimator coloring and sets the width factor for edge distance bands.

logmap.description: Compresses escape-time iteration counts into palette colors with logarithmic or related mappings.

logmode.description: Selects on-the-fly, table, or auto recalculation for logarithmic palette mapping.

map.description: Loads a replacement default color map from a map file.

nobof.description: Makes inside=bof60 and inside=bof61 behave like other inside coloring options.

olddemmcolors.description: Uses the legacy coloring scheme with the distance estimator method.

ranges.description: Maps escape-time iteration ranges, including optional stripes, to palette color numbers.

truecolor.description: Writes truecolor information to a Targa output file.

truemode.description: Selects whether truecolor Targa output stores default colors or escape iteration values.
